part2.question: Describe a time when you worked in a group

segments.v: I want to talk about a time I worked in a group two years ago. After Typhoon Yagi, many families in the north had big problems because of floods. Eight students in my class wanted to help them. We made a book and snack fair at school to get money. Our class monitor Hùng was the leader. He gave everyone a job. I made posters and videos to advertise the fair. Some friends collected books and some made snacks. We had some problems because some friends argued. Hùng talked with them and solved the problem. Finally, we got about fifteen million đồng and we gave it to the flood victims. I felt very proud and happy. I learned that teamwork is very important.
